'''Sudswater Dillifay Glon'''<ref name="Geektionary" /> was a [[Zenezian]]<ref name="Choose Your Destiny" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[Color|brown]]-skinned [[alien]] [[musician]] who played the [[seven-string hallikset]]. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], Glon played at the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] as part of the [[band]] [[Shag Kava]]<ref name="TFA" /> alongside [[Taybin Ralorsa]], [[Ubert Quaril]], and [[Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> While the four performed, Kanata spotted the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] entering the establishment, and yelled to him, causing the band to fall silent. They then resumed their playing, but were soon disturbed again when many of the castle's residents rushed out to witness the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. The castle was then [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the forces of the [[First Order]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sudswater Dillifay Glon was created for [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in [[2015]]. The alien was not identified in the film, but received a name in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released the same day as the film.
